entries.back_en: Always ruining my fun. Maybe I'm just tired of having a sister. You'll be next.
entries.note: Sentido preservado; 'próximo' assume gênero masculino do interlocutor, aceitável.

entries.back_en: I suppose this is 'goodbye', then. Without Baydral, Hafin is saved. The earthquakes have stopped and the dam will no longer burst.
entries.note: 'City' omitido em 'Hafin City', mas sem perda relevante.

entries.back_en: We spent so long thinking we were cursed. When we arrived here, we discovered that Baydral, a legend in our world, had become corrupted over the years, a recluse in this place, and his 'magic' was, in reality, science that turned us into horrible monsters.
Come on Baiyu, don't fall behind.
entries.note: 'linger' vira 'ficar para trás'; sentido próximo o suficiente.

entries.back_en: Baiyu, what are you talking about?
Thank you for everything. You Humans aren't so bad.
